correctness.rationale: The vertex-cover obstruction forces at least n−1 original vertices and as many subdivision vertices; star constructions attain this bound. Equality reduces to a perfect matching between selected originals and selected original-edge incidences. Componentwise edge counts force a nontrivial rooted tree and only unicyclic nonroot components, with 1 and 2 incidence matchings respectively. Cayley rooted trees and unoriented cycles of rooted labelled trees give the exact bivariate EGF. The executable exhaustive n=2..7 comparison checks both the structural bijection and the matching multiplicities; unrestricted conclusions are proved by the component argument.

value.rationale: The known scalar minimum leaves open a natural all-optimum-configuration census. The result classifies every optimum vertex set, counts it exactly for each power-of-two internal matching redundancy, recovers n^{n−1} uniquely matched minima, and identifies the first nonunique boundary at n=5. The rooted tree/unicyclic decomposition is a structural explanation with a reusable exact labelled enumerator, not merely a restatement of the 2016 bound.
